method.next_counterexample_test: 独立检查源/底片/译片入场连续帧及法语当前编码首尾音频。

record.hypothesis: For this source, reviewing native CTA entrance samples and a tail filmstrip exposed a jagged yellow boundary, arrow incision and missing source glyph blur that a readable final hold frame did not exclude. Reusing a prior formal audio track preserved an obsolete clipped French CTA; PCM identity to that earlier version alone could not establish semantic completeness. Recovery of the exact full genuine TTS and exact source-separated bed allowed a new complete-tail mix without a new generation call. These are observations from one source, not a general claim that the visual repair or pronunciation passed.

observations.source_quote: Native entry frame shows a jagged lower yellow boundary and incision above the arrow; local neck texture seams persist.
observations.action_basis: Observed sampled counterexample to final-hold-only visual judgment; inspect entrance and tail against source before accepting a repair.
observations.causal_hypothesis: Overlapping CTA, arrow and neck repair regions may cause the visible boundary defects; no isolated-variable experiment establishes a general cause.

observations.source_record_role: French exact replacement and current endpoint observations
observations.source_quote: Gemini CTA seconds 9.9–11.1 are incorrect. Actual full genuine TTS placement is 20.85–22.380975 with 0.219025 seconds before visual end; no model sync approval adopted.
observations.action_basis: Observed same-source repair: verify intended audio version, recover the full genuine take, mix against exact source bed and review the new actual output. These seconds are source-specific.
observations.causal_hypothesis: Selecting an older formal version carried forward the clipped CTA; the repair addresses that version selection and tail placement, while recognition disagreement prevents a pronunciation pass.
